copy.tagline: 规划、委派、审查并恢复编码代理实施工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编码代理项目中管理任务、审查代码并控制范围
copy.tagline_en: Plan, delegate, review, and recover coding-agent implementation work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage tasks, review code, and control scope in coding-agent projects

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude帮你把模糊的开发需求变成清晰的任务清单，包括目标、范围、验收标准和验证方法，还能检查代码改动是否跑偏。
howto.when: 当你需要给编程助手（如Claude Code、Codex等）分配任务、审查结果或恢复失控的工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个添加GitHub登录的任务。
say.note: Claude会生成包含范围、验收标准等完整任务模板。

say.text: 审查这个编程助手生成的代码改动。
say.note: Claude会按清单检查是否有范围漂移或遗漏验证。

say.text: 这个编程助手的结果不太可信，帮我恢复。
say.note: Claude会要求映射每个改动回原始验收标准。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you turn vague implementation requests into bounded agent tasks with outcome, scope, acceptance criteria, and validation. It also reviews diffs for scope drift and provides recovery prompts.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to assign work to coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex), review their diffs, or recover from stalled or untrustworthy results.

say_en.text: Plan a task to add GitHub OAuth login.
say_en.note: Claude generates a full brief with scope, criteria, etc.

say_en.text: Review the diff from the coding agent.
say_en.note: Claude checks for scope drift and missing validation.

say_en.text: Recover from an untrustworthy agent result.
say_en.note: Claude maps every change back to original criteria.
